label: Xperia 1 V smartphone
description: Sony flagship with a Snapdragon 8 Gen 2 5G sub-6 GHz modem and Wi-Fi 6E (802.11ax) on 2.4, 5 and 6 GHz, 2x2 MIMO.
notes: Wi-Fi 6E — Sony's spec lists IEEE802.11a/b/g/n/ac/ax on 2.4/5/6 GHz, 2x2 MIMO. Cellular: 5G sub-6 GHz plus mmWave (n257/n258/n260/n261 on some SKUs), LTE Cat 19. USB-C 3.2 Gen 2 with Ethernet adapter support (usb0) and microSD expansion. Keeps a 3.5 mm jack and a physical shutter button — irrelevant to L2 but characteristic of the model.
